findings: Desktop company names, audit notice and frozen market labels are readable; the mobile layout wraps company names and explanatory prose without page-width overflow.

All nine full chart figures display titles, legends, fiscal-year labels, axes and captions without missing images or replacement characters. Actual/forecast suffixes and negative INTC EPS/PE remain visible; this is layout review, not validation of those financial assumptions.

CAGR explanations visibly distinguish actual endpoints from forecast endpoints. The AMD range sentence displays the complete 2021A-through-2025A window, 17.9136x (2022A) minimum and 57.1197x (2023A) maximum in both viewport widths.

Every new paragraph Range has line boxes inside both the source section and viewport. Live DOM text matched all eight saved section texts before/after capture, with no report or DOM content modification.
Normal viewport screenshots can show neighboring lines crossing the screenshot boundary; this is not document truncation. The targeted Range clips contain each entire new explanation.
N/A explanatory legends are intentional missing-data disclosures, not broken content. The root QA first attempt and its rule correction remain preserved separately.
semantic_browser_visual_review.limitations: This is a machine visual review of the specified views, not human proofreading, an exhaustive visual scan of every line of the 39k-plus-pixel desktop reports, or a claim that financial statements are factually correct. Browser source-text/hash and geometry checks cover the remaining saved narrative; independent claim audits govern truth.

limitations: Machine labels and visual QA do not prove truth. Historical V6 has 48 contradicted after assertions (8 unflagged); historical V8.2 has 16 (12 unflagged) under its then-current audit. The current V9.1 study reports 0 contradicted after assertions, 0 unflagged contradictions, 1415 unsupported assertions and 51 unverifiable numeric assertions. These are machine-assisted measurements on the development cohort, not human-validated truth or held-out evidence. Historical errors remain preserved as experimental observations. The user requested accurate delivered numbers; experimental outputs must remain identified as imperfect. Medium is published by the user and verified public; the course master PR remains pending user submission from Mac.
